notes: QC-FIX 2026-06-10 (Opus audit): re-keyed from f-manhattan-0009 to f-manhattan-e0008 (the renumbered events-file act-oppenheimer/gatekeeping_event twin this record names) to stop leakage onto act-groves/died. DISPUTE on events-file fact f-manhattan-e0008 (gatekeeping_event): The events file states Oppenheimer's security clearance was 'revoked by AEC 27 May 1954'. The AHF Nuclear Museum (primary archive source) states clearance revoked 'June 29, 1954', noting this was '32 hours before it was set to expire'. The Personnel Security Board issued its adverse recommendation May 27, 1954, but the AEC formal revocation occurred June 29, 1954. The two values refer to different steps in the process: May 27 = board decision; June 29 = AEC formal revocation. Both values retained. value_original (events file): '1954-05-27'; value_found (AHF): '1954-06-29'. The 2022 DOE vacating (events f-manhattan-0009) is corroborated separately.
